tools.name: AffTrack
tools.desc: Affiliate tracking software for performance marketing
pros: Ready to use out of the box, no local install or maintenance
Free tier available, try before you upgrade
cons: Advanced features and higher limits usually require a paid plan
usage:
Step: Open the official site and sign up
Click the red "Visit official site" button to open the AffTrack homepage. Find "Sign Up" and log in with email or Google/GitHub.
Tip:
If the site won’t load, check your connection or try another browser.

Step: Pick the plan that fits you
New users usually get a free trial or free quota. Start with the Free tier before upgrading.
Check:
After sign-up you should see the Dashboard home.

Step: Create your first task / project
Click "New" or "Create New" and follow the guide. Pick the first template to start.
Tip:
Don’t start with a complex request. Test with one simple sentence, e.g. "Summarize this page into 3 points".

Step: Review and save the result
When done, the tool shows the result. Export, copy the link, or save locally.
Check:
If unhappy, click "Regenerate" or tweak the prompt and try again.
tools.detail: AffTrack is a comprehensive affiliate tracking software designed for performance marketing professionals. It provides a robust solution for tracking and managing affiliate campaigns, ensuring accurate commission calculations and detailed analytics. Key features include real-time tracking, customizable commission structures, and detailed reporting. AffTrack is ideal for businesses of all sizes looking to streamline their affiliate marketing efforts. It is particularly useful for those who need to manage a large number of affiliates and track their performance meticulously. Pros include its scalability, robust analytics, and ease of integration with other marketing tools. Limitations may include a steeper learning curve for new users and potentially high costs for larger campaigns.

tools.detail: ClickBank is an online marketplace that connects digital product creators with a vast network of affiliates. It offers a platform for selling digital products, including e-books, software, and membership sites, and provides tools for affiliate marketing. Key features include a user-friendly interface, automated payment processing, and comprehensive reporting. ClickBank is suitable for both product creators and affiliates looking to expand their reach.
